ai_summary.key_headline: Garcia's De Bruyne-Led Red Devils Probe the Pharaohs' Compact Block

belgium.philosophy: Fluid, high-tempo attacking transitions orchestrated by Kevin De Bruyne.

egypt.philosophy: Highly organized defensive mid-block with quick direct plays to Salah and Marmoush.

tactical_insights: Kevin De Bruyne will try to find spaces behind Egypt's midfield line to feed Belgium's quick forwards Doku and Trossard.
Egypt will focus on defensive compactness, relying on Salah and Marmoush for sharp counter-attacking outlets.
With Lukaku restricted to a super-sub role, Belgium's first-half edge hinges on De Bruyne unlocking the Egyptian low block.
